column1: # D3 cleanup: names supported after canonical actor-field analysis (2026-10-27)

column3: Npc_InitArea and Cutscene_StartEntry pass MapSubareaDef.areaSetIndex; loads common NPC overlay and two ROM asset blocks, then DMA-reads the selected npc_area_set_rom_ranges entry.
Battle_EndTurn stores result in player_battle_drop_item; chooses an enemy definition item_id on the battle flag/random roll, otherwise returns 0xFF.
Sets status bit 2; Player and Enemy melee-hit paths test it and heal attacker HP by part of damage dealt, with a status indicator.
Sets status bit 4 and changes ActorBattle.damage_scale_16ths to 0x18 or 0x20; Player/Enemy damage calculations multiply by this live scale.
Sets status bit 8 outside boss battle; Player_Update suppresses movement and Enemy_StateIdle ends the turn when this bit is set.
Sets status bit 0x10 and ActorBattle.unk90 to 0.5 or 2; this factor scales player battle-movement limit and enemy engagement/attack reach.
Sets status bit 0x20 and writes ActorBattle.agility as 2x, 4x or half the base ActorStats.agility; hit/turn calculations use the live value.
Sets status bit 0x40; Player_Update blocks spell input and Enemy_StartAttack ends spell attacks when the bit is set.
Sets status bit 0x80; Hud_DrawEnemyInfo tests that bit to draw max HP, defense, attack power, agility and element details.
Sets status bit 0x100; Magic_UpdateEffects skips the hit handler for targets with this bit except target-select handler 2.
Sets status bit 0x200; Player_TakeDamage and Enemy_TakeDamage add damage amount to MP/secondary resource while still reducing HP.
Sets status bit 0x400 and writes ActorBattle.defense as half, three-quarters, one-and-a-half or twice base defense; damage formula reads live defense.
Text_BuildVisiblePage copies this -1 word into a four-byte choice-order union, marking each choice-row index absent before the scan.
Text_DrawAdvanceIndicator copies its eight-step array and adds each value to icon x while subtracting it from icon y.
Text_DrawAdvanceIndicator uses each step as the width argument when drawing the advance-indicator line texture.
Text_DrawAdvanceIndicator subtracts each step from the advance-indicator line x coordinate before drawing.
